purpose: Public qualitative calibration samples for coarse response trends. They complement public_transfer_guidance.json so agents can reason about off-design robustness without seeing private coefficient targets or exact reward anchors.

representative_public_samples.label: conservative_schema_template
representative_public_samples.qualitative_result: stable and low drag, but low lift authority

representative_public_samples.label: center_of_public_guidance
representative_public_samples.qualitative_result: moderate authority and controlled separation; useful as a starting point, not as an optimized high-authority design

representative_public_samples.label: upper_guidance_edge
representative_public_samples.qualitative_result: higher authority but increased drag and sensitivity risk

representative_public_samples.label: over_aggressive_warning
representative_public_samples.qualitative_result: can look powerful but tends toward drag, blockage, and separation penalties

disclosure_note: The samples and metric windows are public calibration aids for coarse partial credit. They do not disclose hidden operating cases, private case targets, exact high-credit coefficient anchors, or a single official design.
public_transfer_guidance_note: Use public_transfer_guidance.json to reason about speed, trim, Reynolds, and submergence transfer. The samples here are not ranked and are not an official design.
